items.text: No one is on screen except: Archie, James.
Exactly two men are visible: Archie and James, with no third figure.
James is placed where he is in james_meeting_5.png, with the same position and scale.
Archie is placed where he is in james_meeting_5.png, with the same position and scale.
Archie and James look like their sprite masters, with matching outfits, hair and colouring.
James looks straight out at the camera, not at Archie or off to the side.
James's expression is steady and appraising, calm and studying rather than smiling, angry or surprised.
James's face has a subtle shift from blank neutral, such as slightly narrowed eyes or a changed brow.
Archie is still rubbing his face with a hand raised to it.
Archie is not looking at the camera and is not facing James.
The workshop furniture, tools and clutter match james_workshop_blank_plate.png, with nothing added, moved or removed except the two men.
The camera angle and crop match the blank plate and james_meeting_5.png, with both men fully in frame and James's face clearly visible.
The image has the same dimensions and aspect ratio as the blank plate, with no borders or cropping changes.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
